title: Impale gains a Deep Wounds requirement, Predatory Instincts renamed, and a wide spell-scaling pass
summary: The October 8 build adds a 3-point Deep Wounds prerequisite to Warrior Arms' Impale, renames Druid Feral Combat's Predatory Instincts to Natural Instinct (now also adding spell healing from Intellect), removes Water Shield's cooldown, caps Reckoning's extra attack at once per 1.5 sec, and rescales early ranks of several nukes and heals (Fireball, Frostbolt, Arcane Missiles, Lesser Heal, Shadow Bolt, Lightning Bolt, Wrath, Smite, Heal) softer at low ranks and harder at high ranks, alongside a weaker Penance and smaller Thorns/Retribution Aura values.
sourceNote: No official Blizzard forum post for build 70291 was on hand for this update -- every change below is sourced directly from a talentsforever.com data diff (data/sources/talentsforever/diffs/2026-10-04_to_2026-10-08.md) between the 2026-10-04 and 2026-10-08 snapshots (beta client 1.60.1.70170 -> 1.60.1.70291), cross-checked against the session's dev-note brief. If an official post for this build surfaces later, add sourceLabel/sourceUrl and quote its developer notes verbatim here.

warrior.name: Impale
warrior.text: Now requires 3 ranks in Deep Wounds.

warrior.name: Spearing Strike
warrior.text: Now also dismounts mounted targets it hits.

warrior.name: Gore Drinker
warrior.text: Rank 2's health-restore wording clarified to 1.0% (was displayed as 1%); no value change.

paladin.name: Reckoning
paladin.text: The extra attack can no longer occur more often than once every 1.5 sec.

paladin.name: Retribution Aura
paladin.text: Damage per rank reduced (rank 1: 7 -> 5, scaling down similarly through rank 5: 30 -> 20).

hunter.name: Expose Prey
hunter.text: Mongoose Bite activation window increased from 5 sec to 10 sec.

priest.name: Penance
priest.text: Weaker at every rank and costs more Mana. Rank 4: 131 damage / 673 healing for 355 Mana -> 92 damage / 425 healing for 385 Mana.

priest.name: Heal
priest.text: Low ranks softer (rank 1: 282-324 -> 260-300; rank 2: 394-448 -> 364-414); ranks 3-4 unchanged.

shaman.name: Water Shield
shaman.text: No longer has a 15 sec cooldown.

shaman.name: Lightning Bolt
shaman.text: Low ranks softer, high ranks harder (rank 1: 15-17 -> 14-16; rank 4: 55-63 -> 59-67).

mage.name: Fireball
mage.text: Low ranks softer, high ranks harder (rank 1: 16-24 -> 14-22; rank 4: 66-90 -> 68-92).

mage.name: Frostbolt
mage.text: Low ranks softer, high ranks harder (rank 1: 20-22 -> 18-20; rank 4: 61-67 -> 69-77).

mage.name: Arcane Missiles
mage.text: Low ranks softer (rank 1: 25 -> 24 per tick; rank 3: 46 -> 48 per tick).

warlock.name: Shadow Bolt
warlock.text: Low ranks softer, rank 4 harder (rank 1: 12-16 -> 11-15; rank 4: 56-64 -> 58-66).

warlock.name: Demonic Brand
warlock.text: Your pet's bonus attacks now only generate high threat when they deal Shadow damage (previously always generated high threat regardless of damage type).

druid.name: Natural Instinct
druid.text: Renamed, and now also increases spell healing by 12/25% of Intellect in addition to its existing melee critical strike damage bonus.

druid.name: Furor
druid.text: Reworded: Bear/Dire Bear Form now forfeit the Cat Form Energy reserve and halt its restoration while active, rather than only losing the chance to regain it; the Rage/Energy percentages and values are unchanged.

druid.name: Thorns
druid.text: Damage per rank reduced (rank 1: 4 -> 3, scaling down similarly through rank 6: 22 -> 18).
